sources.entry: SwiftMTP - Open-source MTP device manager for browsing and transferring files between Mac and Android devices. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Neighbor-Z/SwiftMTP) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: SwiftMTP is an open-source, Swift-based macOS app and command-line tool for browsing and transferring files between a Mac and MTP devices such as Android phones.
summary.what_it_does: SwiftMTP lets users connect MTP devices to a Mac, browse device directories, and import or export files, including drag-and-drop and paste-to-import. It supports creating folders, renaming and deleting files on the device, and shows real-time transfer progress with the ability to cancel transfers. Quick Look preview works on device files, and a natural-language search feature is described for finding files. A device info analysis feature reports hardware and connectivity details. The README also describes swiftmtp-cli, a command-line interface built on a Gomtp backend, which is intended for use with AI agents.
use_cases: transfer files between Mac and Android phone
browse Android device storage from macOS
drag and drop photos from phone to Mac
manage MTP device files without ADB
command-line MTP file transfer on macOS
copy files from a camera to a Mac
how_to_run: brew tap neighbor-z/swiftmtp && brew install --cask swiftmtp
Select macOS as the target platform and press Run
notable: Swift-native macOS app inspired by OpenMTP, with a Go-based MTP backend
Command-line tool swiftmtp-cli bundled in the app, with a usage guide for AI agents
No ADB or USB debugging required on the Android device
Natural-language file search and device info analysis features
caveats: Requires Xcode 15.0+ and macOS 12.0+ to build
Conflicts can occur with Preview, Image Capture, or Android File Transfer holding MTP sessions
macOS may block the app because it is not notarized with a paid Apple developer signature; a quarantine-removal command is provided
keywords: drag and drop files to phone
